GENERATE BURST CS-vfx-frozenorb-sheets-v2 — greyscale PAINTED-PIXEL effect sheets for FROZEN ORB (breadth test kit 1: d2-frozen-orb-sorc; style card v0). task_id "CS-vfx-frozenorb-sheets-v2".

Paint ONE 1536×1024 image on flat PURE BLACK #000000: a 6-column × 4-row grid of 256×256 cells (each effect drawing centred in its cell, never touching the cell edge), GREYSCALE ONLY (white → light grey → mid grey → dark grey, no colour), in a PAINTED-PIXEL register: each drawing looks like a hand-painted sprite at a small native size — hard-edged shapes, 3–4 flat value steps, a near-white core, dark grey rim/interior holes, ABSOLUTELY NO soft gradients, NO glow, NO haze, NO bloom, NO radial light falloff around any shape, NO blur, NO anti-aliasing, NO outline strokes: every pixel is one of exactly FIVE values — pure black background, dark grey #404040, mid grey #808080, light grey #C0C0C0, pure white #FFFFFF — with hard, stair-stepped edges as if drawn with a 1-px pencil at 64 px and scaled up 4x with nearest-neighbour. Think 1990s 16-bit sprite effects (Diablo I / Secret of Mana spell sprites) drawn in greyscale, NOT a modern glowing render. If you are tempted to make anything glow, draw a ring of light-grey pixels instead. Design it as an ice/frost effect (crystals, shards, frost mist) even though it is greyscale.
ROW 1 — CAST (6 frames, left to right in time): a swirl of frost gathering at a point, growing from a few motes into a bright compact orb with a white core.
ROW 2 — TRAVEL (6 frames): the orb in flight, drawn facing RIGHT: a bright crystalline sphere with a short streak of frost mist trailing to the LEFT; frames vary the spinning facets and mist so they loop.
ROW 3 — IMPACT (6 frames): the orb shatters: frame 1 a flat white flash disc; then radial ice shards burst outward with a ring; then the shards thin and the ring breaks; the last frame is a few small dark fragments.
ROW 4 — RESIDUAL + SHARD (6 frames): frames 1–4: a frost patch on the ground (drawn as a flat ellipse, wider than tall) fading in value steps; frames 5–6: one single ice shard projectile drawn facing RIGHT (a small bright dart with a tiny mist tail), two spin variants.
Every drawing must read at 25 % size (64 px cells). Nothing between cells; no labels, grid lines, text or border; background pure black.

One image_gen call. ONE retry only if colour appears, any glow/haze/gradient appears, cells bleed into each other, or a row is missing — name the reason. Copy the output from $CODEX_HOME/generated_images/... to out/frozenorb_sheets_v2.png with sha256. No code. No other files. No web.
RETURN: receipt task_id "CS-vfx-frozenorb-sheets-v2"; images = the file with prompt, references and elapsed_s; calls_used = the TRUE number of image_gen calls; status; concerns. Never PASS/FAIL.
